_readme: Ground-truth labels for source cmsnmcbec005ouhfj30l0w4qm (48-min ru nuclear podcast, recorded as fixture podcast-nuclear on 2026-08-10). Keyed by SOURCE TIME RANGES, never clip ids. 'range' is the best estimate of the MOMENT's true extent (scout consensus where one exists, production boundaries otherwise); 'productionRange' preserves what production actually shipped when the two differ: the shipped set differs run to run (production shipped 12 clips on 2026-08-10; the fixture re-record shipped 8 from the same transcript the same day), so evaluations must match clips to labels by time overlap. provenance per label: 'owner' = named by the owner looking at production clips; 'scout-consensus' = >=2 of 3 blind clip-scout agreement (protocol of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-04-clip-quality-programme-design.md §3.2), run 2026-08-10 on the segment-level transcript, timestamps accurate to a few seconds; 'fable-read' = read from stored subtitleTrack cues by the architect session, not owner-confirmed.

moments.productionTitle: Что увидела мать после возвращения дочери?
moments.note: Title is the girl's story, opening is the boy's ('Он ехал на велосипеде'). All three scouts open the arc 61.5s earlier, on the host's question 'Что произошло с людьми, которые пережили взрыв в Хиросиме и Нагасаки?'. The production end matches consensus. The critic itself cited node 738 in _descriptionEvidenceNodes while shipping _startNode 740. STRUCTURAL FACT: the consensus arc 1466-1571 is 105s, ABOVE maxSec 90 - the engine cannot ship it whole and must cut somewhere; production cut the entry (started 1527.5), the fixture re-record cut the exit (1466.7-1483.4, 16.7s, before either story completes). Same moment, broken in opposite directions by two runs of the same engine.

moments.productionTitle: Миллиарды погибнут не там, где упадёт бомба
moments.note: Opens 'Это миллиарды...' - antecedent outside. Two scouts take the full 66s arc from 'принцип предосторожности'; the production clip is its last 16s. Production end matches consensus end.

moments.productionTitle: Что на самом деле происходит с человеком после облучения
moments.note: Opens 'И можно ли ее избежать' - the first half of the question ('что такое лучевая болезнь') is outside. Two scouts end 26s later on 'он уже труп живой... автомат он все еще держит' (2803); production ends 2777.

moments.productionTitle: Правда ли, что водка спасает от радиации?

scoutConsensus.agreement: 3/3 start; 2/3 END ON THE PRODUCTION LINE, 1/3 extends to 2004 ('полный консенсус, что алкоголь не помогает')

moments.note: DISAGREEMENT RECORDED: the owner reads 'Поэтому давайте водку мы сразу отложим' as a cut-off transition; two of three scouts read it as the verdict line and end there. Do not treat this exit label as settled ground truth.

moments.productionTitle: Почему ядерное оружие до сих пор не запретили?

scoutConsensus.agreement: loose 3/3 on the moment (starts 730/739/770, ends 787/811/814); none picks the intro copy

moments.note: Cut from the intro region (7.4s); every scout and the fixture re-record (777.0-802.1) place the complete moment at ~12:10-13:30. The production clip is the teaser-region copy of it.

moments.productionTitle: Самая честная стратегия на случай ядерной атаки

scoutConsensus.agreement: 3/3, start exact to the second, ends 1693/1693/1696

moments.note: Production shipped 8.2s - the opening aphorism only. All three scouts take the 74s arc ending 'Если противник захотел вас убить вместе с вашим городом, он вас убьет. И да, может быть один из десяти тысяч выживет.' An earlier draft of this file called the 8s clip fine; the consensus falsified that.

moments.productionTitle: Что такое ядерная зима и как она возникает
moments.note: Opens 'И проверять это на практике', ends '...чтобы корректно быть'. NO scout picked this moment at all.

moments.productionTitle: Как понять, можно ли есть продукты после радиации

scoutConsensus.agreement: 3/3 exact - but as a 20s micro-clip ending on 'Белорусского сыра без стронция не бывает', ranked weakest (11-12) by all three

moments.note: Production runs 50s past the consensus punchline into the dosimetry-services tail and ends mid-enumeration ('или нет Вот сейчас...').

moments.productionTitle: Где человек почти ничего не успеет почувствовать?
moments.note: POSITIVE CONTROL: production boundaries match the consensus almost exactly, and the fixture re-record ships it too (1113.8-1132.3). The engine can hit; an audit that flags this clip is over-firing.

missedMoments.agreement: 3/3 (starts 1041/1041/1029, ends 1075/1071/1072); ranked #1 by two of three scouts

missedMoments.note: Not shipped by production OR the fixture re-record. The strongest recall miss.

missedMoments.hook: Нёнокса: город Северодвинск два часа сидел в облаке радиоактивных газов

episodeCeiling: All three scouts independently: the episode holds 8-9 genuinely postable moments, not 12 - a fixed quota of 12 forces weak picks. The fixture re-record shipping 8 is consistent with that ceiling; production shipped ~5 moments no scout chose.
sourceProperty: Scout 2: 'almost every answer trails off mid-thought, so nearly all endings need hard cuts rather than natural landings' - an exit-side property of this source class (single-expert scripted-question lecture).
